definition: One of the three federal economic immigration programmes managed through Express Entry, for tradespeople with qualifying work experience in a skilled trade occupation.
longform: It requires a certificate of qualification from a Canadian provincial, territorial or federal authority, or a valid job offer where the destination province does not certify that trade, in addition to skilled trade work experience and minimum language scores.
